examples.cue: A result from the service is not itself permission

examples.quote: Use the botanical Taxonomic Name Resolution Service to suggest resolutions for unresolved plant names. Keep the existing local workflow usable without the service or its optional R client. Request one explicit plant reference database per run, retain alternative results and warnings, and return suggestions for review. A result from the service is not itself permission to rename a record or assign a tree tip.
